body:
Refreshed for merge: merged origin/main into the branch (merge commit 862536f73, no rebase, no force).

Hand-resolved files:
- crates/ui/src/state.rs: both sides added a `#[path]` module line (`state_move_by.rs` here, `state_align.rs` on main); kept both.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs: conflicted as a whole file. Took main's version (which already carries the #979 pick box, #1507 hover, gcode_view and viewport_layout changes) and re-applied this PR's five body-drag hunks on top: the press guard (`move_drag::press`), Escape cancel, release routing, motion routing and `update_hover` flag, plus the `move_handles::draw` call. The body-drag branches sit before main's pick-box and orbit branches, so a ball drag wins and the pick box and orbit are unchanged otherwise.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on the merged head: ui lib unit tests plus the boundary, boundary_picks, feedback, fixtures, gpu_render, machine, models, operations, shell, sinker_setup and theme_files suites, all green (228 s).

Not exercised: pixel snapshots (release lane), the GUI by hand (the PR's own hand check is still owed), other crates' suites.

The PR is still a draft. Ready for a re-check.

Refreshed for merge: merged origin/main (d1484f02a) into the branch. The merge commit is e50da95c3. There was no rebase and no force-push. The PR stays a draft.

What main brought that touched this PR: four new buttons in the viewport bar (Projection, Orbit, Pan, Zoom) and a latched nav tool (`state.nav_tool`) that owns a viewport press.

Hand-resolved files (both sides kept):
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar.rs`: The bar keeps all buttons. `Nav::Move` stays after `PickThrough`, and main's four buttons follow it. `NAV_COUNT` is now 11 and `BAR_W` is sized for 11 buttons. The enum, `act`, the "on" state and the icon match each have the arms of both sides.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`: The press block uses main's structure. When a nav tool is latched, the tool owns the press. When no nav tool is latched, the PR's ball-press guard (`move_drag::press`) runs as before, so a press on a ball does not pick or orbit. The Escape cancel, the release routing, the motion routing and the handle draw call merged with no conflict.

Result: the move stays one `MoveModelBy` command with one undo step. If a nav tool is latched, a left press goes to that tool and not to a move ball.

Diff against main: only the 13 files of this PR. The line ends of each file are the same as on main.

Tests (debug, `-j 6`):
- camcraft-ui lib: 826 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. This includes `body_drag` and `move_drag_tests` (10 tests), `viewport_bar::tests::bar_fits_its_buttons`, the view-cube HUD law and the structural twin.
- camcraft-ui `--test shell`: 21 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Class: DELTA (two conflicts resolved by hand). A delta review of the remerge-diff is necessary.

File sizes: `shell.rs` has 1043 lines (main has 1028). `viewport_bar.rs` has 461 lines (main has 433). Both files were already over 400 lines on main. The merge adds only the lines of this PR.

Notes:
- The PR body has no before/after screenshots. A UI PR needs them. The GUI hand check is also still owed.
- The Move icon (four arms with balls) and main's new Pan icon (four arrows) look similar. A reviewer must examine this on screen.
- Not run: pixel snapshots (release lane), the other ui integration suites, the GUI by hand.

Ready for a re-check.

Merged main to make the branch current (merge commit `58df4b729`, main at `17a8c6e76`). The merge had no conflicts and no hand edits. There was no rebase and no force-push. The PR stays a draft.

Targeted gate on the new head (debug, `-j 6`):
- camcraft-ui lib, filter `body_drag move_drag viewport_bar view_cube structural pick_through box_select`: 37 passed, 0 failed.
- camcraft-ui `--test shell`: 21 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Law check: the release of a drag queues one `MoveModelBy`, and the drain runs one `MoveModel` through the history. That is one undo step. The preview is display only. The MCP `move_model` tool already covers this command, so no new MCP tool is necessary.

The PR body now has offscreen screenshots from the kittest harness, the refresh section and the test names. The rotate handles (slice c) are now #2047.

No collaborator review marker exists for any head of this PR. Thus `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta` has no reviewed head to compare, and the PR needs a full review.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
